officialText:
(a) All conveyors shall be inspected and tested as per Table N1 of ASME A17.1 as modified by Chapter K1 of this appendix.

(b) All safety devices shall be tested on all tests. A static full load shall be performed every five years to ensure that the conveyor holds the load.
